A persistent memory plugin for Claude Code (kb v0.7.0)

USAGE kb init|doctor|uninstall|recall|map|get-node|get|list-topics|read-raw|read-session|capture-session|mark-extracted|sessions|summarize|summaries

COMMANDS

             init    Initialize a KB vault                                       
           doctor    Report KB vault + dependency health                         
        uninstall    Remove KB (preserves vault)                                 
           recall    Search curated wiki pages                                   
              map    Project a compact structural map of the wiki for navigation 
         get-node    Fetch exact page or section content by node ID              
              get    Fetch a curated wiki page                                   
      list-topics    List curated topic headings from the vault index            
         read-raw    Read a bounded excerpt from raw/ with explicit approval     
     read-session    Read a bounded excerpt from sessions/ with explicit approval
  capture-session    Capture a Claude Code Stop event as a KB session manifest   
   mark-extracted    Mark a session manifest as extracted (sets extracted: true) 
         sessions    List session manifest names (never content)                 
        summarize    Generate or return a cached session summary                 
        summaries    Manage cached session summaries                             

Use kb <command> --help for more information about a command.
